parts.answer: The required region is outside or on the circle centred at the origin with radius $2$ and inside or on the circle centred at $1-i$ with radius $1$.

Show the point representing $1-i$ — B1.

Shade the appropriate region — B1 FT. Guidance: FT is on the position of $1-i$. Shaded region outside circle with centre the origin and radius $2$ and inside circle with centre $\pm1\pm i$ and radius $1$ (as printed).
